toolProblems: Browser pane key injection performs no native default action: keydown events reach the page (proven with a capture-phase listener that logged Backspace/Enter/Escape on the focused input) but Backspace/Delete do not edit text and Enter/Space do not activate a focused button. Escape still works wherever the app handles it in JS (dialogs, menus). Consequence: REAL-16 keyboard activation is BLOCKED and the 'Clear filters' non-activation must NOT be read as an app defect.

javascript_tool readouts taken shortly after `navigate` can evaluate against a stale document: on /create and on both canvases the JS reported an empty <main> with only an animate-pulse skeleton for 20-40s while a screenshot taken seconds later in the SAME batch showed the finished page. Screenshots were treated as authoritative; no slow-load claim is made from the DOM timings.
One javascript_tool call on /create timed out after 45s; re-issuing it immediately returned normally.
computer:zoom region cropping is not supported in this pane (returns the full screenshot).
Click coordinates must be given in the screenshot frame (e.g. 800x450) rather than the emulated CSS viewport (1280x720); ref-based clicks avoid the mismatch.
read_network_requests buffers only the most recent requests per tab and had dropped 348 earlier ones; PerformanceResourceTiming.responseStatus was used instead for the per-page 4xx/5xx sweep.
